India Prepares for 80th Independence Day Celebrations

India is approaching its 80th Independence Day, scheduled for August 15, 2026. The occasion is being marked by a focus on reflection, celebration of national heritage, and reaffirmation of commitment to progress. Various media outlets are providing collections of wishes, messages, quotes, and social media statuses for citizens to share.
